policy: Reviewed official UATs that lack a distinct current OSM administrative-boundary representation. These classifications preserve official legal identity and prohibit promotion of another OSM relation to legal geometry. An explicitly reviewed ANCPI/RELUAT UAT polygon may be used as fallback geometry only when its exact source feature, SIRUTA code and provenance are bound.

items.review_conclusion: SIRUTA 64096 is a current legal UAT and OSM still has no distinct Brețcu/Bereck boundary relation; relation 14735731 remains Ojdula and must not be promoted. The current ANCPI/RELUAT UAT feature with nationalCode 64096 is accepted as an explicit fallback administrative-boundary representation, with SIRUTA retaining legal identity authority and no claim that OSM supplies this geometry.

fallback_geometry.authority: Agenția Națională de Cadastru și Publicitate Imobiliară
